g.title: The garage door: remote control commands in, statistics out.
Opens and closes the door; implemented by controller.devm.
out async up : integer (sends the event)
out async down : integer (sends the event)
out sync cycles : integer (sends the data)
inout sync errors : integer (shares the data)
in sync position : door::Position (receives the data)
out sync position : door::Position (sends the data)
in sync cycles : integer (receives the data)
inout sync errors : integer (shares the data)
out sync report : Diagnostics (sends the data)
Motor control, PWM output and end switches.
Subsystem DriveUnit (has an internal block diagram)
in async up : integer (receives the event)
in async down : integer (receives the event)
out sync report : Diagnostics (sends the data)
